items.prompt: With ties, what does exchange prove?

options.why: Ties can allow several minimum spanning trees; the exchange does not prove uniqueness.
An equal-weight alternative can replace an edge, so no claim that every light edge is mandatory follows.
Accepting all tied edges can create cycles; DSU still filters each candidate.
The invariant is existence of at least one MST containing the current forest, even when other MSTs use different tied edges.

items.explanation: Existence, not membership in every optimum.
